A [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Species/Legends|species]], the '''Ilosians''' [[Homeworld/Legends|hailed]] from the [[Agriworld/Legends|agricultural world]] [[Ilos]]. [[Millennium/Legends|Millennia]] before the [[Imperial Era/Legends|reign]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], the Ilosians [[Colonist/Legends|settled]] many nearby [[Planet/Legends|worlds]] before becoming engulfed in [[Hutt Space/Legends|Hutt Space]] and [[Slavery/Legends|enslaved]] by the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutts]]. The Ilosians, however, preserved relatively more freedom than other species in the Hutts' servitude.

==Society and culture==
The Ilosians were a [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Species/Legends|species]] [[Homeworld/Legends|native]] to the [[Hutt Space/Legends|Hutt Space]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] [[Ilos]], which was a bland [[Agriworld/Legends|agriworld]] with numerous [[City/Legends|cities]]. The species exhibited both economic clout and technological prowess.<ref name="TEA" />

==Ilosians in the galaxy==
[[File:Ilos-TEA.jpg|thumb|right|300px|The Ilosians were native to Ilos.]]
[[Millennium/Legends|Millennia]] before the [[Imperial Era/Legends|reign]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]],<ref name="TEA" /> which [[Declaration of a New Order|began]] in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]],<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> the Ilosians [[Colonist/Legends|settled]] hundreds of nearby worlds. [[Ilos Minor]] was one such colony, and the [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] known as the [[Ilosian Spur/Legends|Ilosian Spur]] also linked Ilos to the agricultural world [[Alee]]. The latter was home to the sentient [[Vippit]]s but also hosted a large Ilosian minority<ref name="TEA" /> who were mostly employed as [[Farmer/Legends|farmhands]] and agricultural workers.<ref name="LoNH">''[[Lords of Nal Hutta]]''</ref> Ilos Minor in turn served as a transfer point for goods transported from the planets of the Ilosian Spur.<ref name="TEA" />

Eventually, Hutt Space, the realm of the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] species, grew to encompass the Ilosian worlds, and the latter species was [[Slavery/Legends|enslaved]]; however, their skills allowed them to preserve relatively more freedom than other species subjugated by the Hutts. During the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]] of [[25 ABY/Legends|25 ABY]]&ndash;[[29 ABY/Legends|29 ABY]], the [[Yuuzhan Vong galaxy|extra-galactic]] [[Yuuzhan Vong]] invaded Hutt Space, and they were believed to have inflicted heavy suffering upon the Ilosians.<ref name="TEA" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Ilosians were first mentioned in ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', a [[2009]] reference book written by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]].<ref name="TEA" />
